62: Understood
63: Free mode is for casual battles against\nother Pokémon fans around the world.\c\nFeel free to challenge it!\c
64: Rating mode is recommended for those who\nwant to master battles.\c\nWhen communication is established, you\nare likely to battle against a person with\r\na similar Rating.\c\nYour Rating starts at 1500. When you win,\nit goes up. When you lose, it goes down.\c\nSo the higher your Rating is, the\nstronger you are as a Trainer!\c\nThere's one thing you should be careful\nabout in Rating mode.\c\nYour record and Rating will be erased if\nyou connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection\r\nwith a different DS System.\c\nSo please be careful if you switch!\c
65: There are several special rules\nfor Random Matchups.\c\nAny Pokémon higher than Lv. 50 will be\nset to that level for the battle.\c\nPokémon nicknames won't be used.\c\nYou have a limited time to choose Pokémon\nfor a battle and to give orders to your\r\nPokémon during the battle.\c\nDon't exceed the time limit,\nor your Pokémon and its moves\r\nwill be chosen for you!\c\nThere's also a time limit on the battle.\c\nThe winner will be determined when time\nruns out, even if both sides still have\r\nPokémon standing.\c
